items.headline: U.S.-Iran escalation around Strait of Hormuz keeps oil and broad market risk elevated
items.summary: Reuters reports U.S. strikes on Iranian missile launchers at Larak Island, Iranian retaliation against U.S. forces in Jordan, a tanker incident in the Strait of Hormuz and sharply reduced shipping visibility; Brent traded above $90 as markets repriced inflation and rate risk. Trump's separate claim that Kharg Island was being destroyed is not treated as confirmed because neither the White House nor Pentagon substantiated it and Reuters reported no evidence.
items.whyItMatters: Escalation around the Strait of Hormuz can reprice oil, inflation expectations, yields, the dollar and global risk appetite, transmitting directly into crypto volatility across the monitored universe.
items.actionReason: The verified military and shipping escalation remains a HIGH-impact macro shock. Positive or negative price reaction does not create a Crypto Reca buy or sell signal.

items.headline: Coinbase resolves delayed HBAR sends and receives
items.summary: Coinbase reported delayed HBAR sends and receives beginning Aug. 28 at 22:04 PDT and marked the incident resolved Aug. 29 at 14:50 PDT. Buys, sells and fiat deposits/withdrawals were unaffected; Hedera's status page showed the mainnet operational after its v0.76.3 upgrade.
items.whyItMatters: Exchange transfer availability can temporarily affect HBAR deposit/withdrawal liquidity, but no Hedera network-wide outage was verified.
items.actionReason: The transfer incident is resolved and trading remained available; it does not create an entry, exit or risk instruction.

items.headline: U.S. spot ether ETFs record $102.1M net inflows on Aug. 28
items.summary: Farside Investors shows $102.1M of net inflows into U.S. spot ether ETFs on Aug. 28, led by ETHA +$83.8M and ETHB +$42.6M, partly offset by FETH -$24.3M.
items.whyItMatters: A fourth consecutive strong positive session extends the regulated-product demand signal for ETH despite the broader hawkish macro backdrop.
items.actionReason: Positive ETF flows are contextual only and never create a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: U.S. spot bitcoin ETFs close Aug. 28 with $201.9M net outflows
items.summary: Farside's direct table shows a reconciled Aug. 28 total of -$201.9M, including IBIT -$33.4M, BITB -$49.7M, ARKB -$114.9M, HODL -$13.2M and MSBT +$9.3M.
items.whyItMatters: The negative session breaks the prior nine-session inflow streak and is a material short-term regulated-flow deterioration.
items.actionReason: Material negative flow context does not override Crypto Reca hard gates and does not independently create a sale, reduce or new-entry instruction.

items.headline: U.S. spot Solana ETFs record $17.3M net inflows on Aug. 28
items.summary: Farside Investors shows $17.3M of net inflows into U.S. spot Solana ETFs on Aug. 28, following a materially stronger prior session.
items.whyItMatters: The positive regulated-product flow continues, but at a materially slower pace than the prior session.
items.actionReason: Constructive context only; positive news never creates a Crypto Reca buy signal.

items.headline: Solana validators narrowly pass faster-disinflation proposal SGP-0002; SGP-0003 fails
items.summary: CoinDesk reports SGP-0002 finished with about 67% support, barely above the two-thirds threshold; SGP-0003 failed with about 54% support.
items.whyItMatters: The governance mandate supports faster reductions in future SOL issuance if implemented.
items.actionReason: Material fundamental resolution, not a Crypto Reca entry trigger.

catalysts.headline: Ripple monthly XRP escrow release window opens
catalysts.summary: Public XRP Ledger tracking indicates that up to 1 billion XRP is scheduled to become releasable from escrow on Sept. 1. The amount actually entering circulation cannot be known in advance because unused XRP is commonly re-escrowed.
catalysts.sourceName: XRP Insights / XRP Ledger escrow tracking
catalysts.whyItMatters: The event can temporarily focus attention on XRP supply, but the headline unlock is not equivalent to a 1 billion XRP market sale or net supply increase.
catalysts.actionReason: Scheduled recurring supply event; wait for validated on-chain EscrowFinish and re-escrow activity before drawing supply conclusions.

catalysts.headline: U.S. Employment Situation for August 2026
catalysts.summary: The U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics schedules the August 2026 Employment Situation report for Sept. 4 at 8:30 a.m. ET (14:30 Madrid).
catalysts.whyItMatters: Payrolls, unemployment and wage data can materially reprice Fed expectations, yields and the dollar.
catalysts.actionReason: More than 24 hours away; no escalation yet.
